outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot of quantified data.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field images (micrographs), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart of mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for Normal lung, LUAD, and LUSC groups, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel D is a bar chart of mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for high pH and low pH regions, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a data plot.
